comment: Hand edits applied on top of OSM when building the Brisbane pack. `add`: places OSM misses ({id, name, lon, lat, kind, address, note}); ids start with 'manual:'. `include`: OSM ids kept even when their tags don't match the layer's rules. `exclude`: OSM ids to drop (closed, moved, wrong). Every entry goes to the venues layer unless it names another point layer in `layer` (e.g. "osm:cuisine=kebab"); `kind` is for venues only. Include/exclude entries are an id string or {id, note, layer}. The build warns about ids it no longer finds. Per-game curation happens in the lobby.
